question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) as month,
        SUM(amount) as monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date)
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(monthly_total) as total_amount
    FROM monthly_totals
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
top_10_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM customer_totals
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
customer_monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        mt.customer_id,
        mt.month,
        mt.monthly_total,
        LAG(mt.monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY mt.customer_id ORDER BY mt.month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_totals mt
    WHERE mt.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top_10_customers)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month,
        ROUND(cm.monthly_total - cm.prev_month_total, 2) as month_over_month_diff
    FROM customer_monthly cm
    WHERE cm.prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM with_diff
WHERE month_over_month_diff = 77.83
